items.note: S1.1.1 states the restored-scratch exchange and its sub-steps follow the proof at 741-765 step for step: net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2 with side cancellation, and (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). The plan never gives h=100, the two neighbour rules (|S∩T|=1 or even intersection) or the wire counts (767-783), and it calls the gates 'XOR' while adding 'up to a sign', which mixes the two constructions.

The plan states nondegenerate nested labels in an m-dimensional space, built from triple indicator lines with <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1, the only loss h on the central 3->4 edge, L=Ich, the sum Wm-2N+2L and both ratios 100/539 and 101/539. s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m is stated, and the rank argument (rank equals dimension change, with the N negative source projections giving 2P_{U_a} of rank one) follows 1156-1166. The plan never states the endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m or the assignment of P_U to gates and sinks; S1.1.6.3 only cites 'the endpoint condition'. The check P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m (1169-1171) is missing.

S2.1 gives the phase frame C_U=H^{⊗m}diag(i^{wt(P_U x)})H^{⊗m} and one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, with the weight-additivity mod 4 idea only as a one-line method; no sub-step follows the proof at 1231-1315. The formula s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m is never given, and the conclusion that the diagonal corrections (Z_{a,k}, i^{27k}) leave C^{⊗m} on every role is not stated.

For the bit network the plan gives L/N<1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0, eta_b=339/22587335000000>20·2^{-50} and the inequality chain giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. The complex case (eta_c=73/19906842167500, s_c<W_c m, s_c/W_c<m^sigma) is not stated, and log m<20, which justifies the first inequality of the chain, is left implicit.

The plan uses 'elementary stream operation', 'controlled shifts' and the cyclic row split at O(V) cost, but it never states either lemma's content: the list of digit operations, or the update y->y+a(controls) mod q^b with offset cost b^{O(1)} and the conditions on q and the rational units.

The factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 (pivot at the rightmost entry of the topmost row, lower-triangular operations, a rank-one block per pivot) and the shear schedule (E_2, E_1^{-1}, Pi D, inverses, one interchange per one of Pi) follow 1375-1446 exactly. The choice of the fixed prime q is not mentioned.

The plan follows 1491-1588 in order: F_0 by a single-digit operation, the cyclic split into W role streams of volume V/W, frames Phi_M giving Phi_{I_m}, the three-update interchange, s calls, the recurrence, the geometric sum split at a<=1 and a>1, and the fixed-tape parking schedule. The requirement that the row field be divisible by W^k appears in S1's motivation.

The O(Vu^tau) statement and the three moves (high rho digits as a row field, base-m pieces, padding [2^u] to [q^e]) match 1649-1734. Appending zero rows to reach a multiple of W^k (1684-1690), which the power-width proposition requires, is missing: S1.2 says only 'at least W^k rows'.

errors.says: A fixed network of XOR gates on W wires exchanges two banks X,Y (up to a sign).
errors.paper: Only the bit construction over F_2 uses XOR gates, and there the exchange is an exact permutation. The signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) comes from the complex construction over Z[i,1/2], whose gates include halving and side coefficients -(|S∩T|-1)/2, which are not XOR gates.

errors.says: Each edge change is a product of two-point kernels C=HSH=aI+bX (translations of the array), one per orthonormal residual vector.
errors.paper: Each factor is a directional kernel aI+bX_v, or its inverse, for a residual vector v. Each is a combination of the identity and a translation by v, not C itself. It becomes C on a coordinate only after conjugating by P_M.

errors.says: Setup at recursion nodes, descriptors, prime search and the compact sorting of exceptional records are o(V) because the number of visits is polynomial in p while r exceeds every fixed power of p.
errors.paper: That reason covers setup and per-record descriptor work only. The exceptional sorting is o(V) because its cost is O(Vp^{A'}2^{-K}) with K=Theta(p^{epsilon c}), and the prime search is o(V) because it takes n^{o(1)} time.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from start to finish: a bit network with total rank s<Wm, its recurrence and arbitrary widths (S1); the complex network, packed XORs, the layer recurrence and guard bits (S2); transforms, convolution, resampling and chirp, assembly with exact recovery, and the time table (S3-S7). It thins out at the network interfaces: the sizes h=100, N and m are never defined, the endpoint identity M_sink-M_source=I_m is only cited, and the complex interface's s_c formula and its C^{⊗m}-on-every-role conclusion are asserted without derivation. Smaller gaps are the absorption of K into e^lambda in the layer recurrence and the intermediate error budgets.

steps.note: The signed exchange (x,y)->(-y,x) and the restoration of every scratch wire are reconstructed. h=100, the indexing of X_a,Y_a by triples, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear. The plan writes only 'three-element subsets of [h]', and m and N are used without definition, so the defining sizes are missing.
A common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the intermediate frames are free so that each edge costs only a change of frame.

Nondegenerate labels in an m-dimensional space built as tensor products of triple indicator lines, comparable labels along every edge, and the only decrease on the central 3->4 edge, losing P⊗F⊗Q of dimension h.

S1.1.4.4 says matrix rank equals the dimension change on every edge, except the N source edges where 2P_{U_a} has rank one with dimension change zero. The general fact rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U and the assignment of P_U to gates are left implicit.
Signed sum Wm-2N, Ic decreasing edges each losing h so L=Ich, absolute sum Wm-2N+2L, and the extra N source ranks giving s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m.

The plan states the result, the shear H<-H+D on every role including scratch, but cites only 'the endpoint condition'. It never states M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m, nor how the negative source projection makes it hold (P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m; 0 to identity on other roles).
A=E_1 Pi E_2, a shear of rank a costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and the recursive calls at a node total s.

Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), eta_b>20·2^{-50} with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50})>m(1-eta) giving s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau). The bound log m<20 is used inside the inequality but not stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs seven of the nine steps: frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget, the strict saving, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The chain breaks at its two ends of definition: the fixed network's sizes (h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3) are never set, and the endpoint identity M_sink-M_source=I_m, which turns the network into the shear H<-H+D, is only cited as 'the endpoint condition'.
